items.caption:
Are you taller in the morning? Yes, by about 2 cm.
In a 1984 study, height peaked on waking and was about 1.1% lower by midnight: spine discs lose volume when you are upright and refill when you lie down. It varies by person.

items.caption:
Can you know you're dreaming, inside a dream?
About 55% of people say they've had a lucid dream, 23% monthly or more. In 2021, lucid dreamers in REM sleep answered simple questions with eye movements, but only about 18% of tries were right.
Have you ever realized you were dreaming?

items.caption:
What do people say in their sleep?
In one Paris sleep lab, 232 adults (mostly patients) were recorded: the top word was 'no', and about 1 in 10 clauses had swearing.
What have you been told you say in your sleep?

items.caption:
There is a disease that ends sleep.
Fatal familial insomnia is an inherited prion disease that takes away the ability to sleep. It is extremely rare, and ordinary insomnia does not turn into it.
